metadata.title: Architecture Editor — Visual Collaboration Tool
metadata.goal: Build #Architecture tab in UX Lab: Excalidraw canvas + project list + element inspector + Save to Memory + Create Plan button. Agent can read/write canvas programmatically.

capability_overlap: /memory recall: no prior architecture diagram tool
CALL: LeftPane.tsx (project list with right-click context menu)
CALL: ModelPicker.tsx pattern for toolbar controls
CREATE: @excalidraw/excalidraw npm package for canvas — no existing Excalidraw skill, pure npm dependency
CREATE: Express API endpoints for agent read/write — /ux-lab server pattern, not a new skill
GLUE: ArangoDB persistence via daemon /learn endpoint — reuses existing daemon, no new endpoints
Anti-silo: /create-figure exists but is static image generation, not interactive canvas — no overlap

definition_of_done.assertion: Package resolves without error — prints OK

tasks.title: Add /api/architecture Express endpoints to ux-lab server
tasks.gate: API returns valid JSON with architectures key
implementation: Add routes to /home/graham/workspace/experiments/pi-mono/packages/ux-lab/server/index.ts
GET /api/architecture — list all architecture projects (from ArangoDB via daemon /list with filter)
GET /api/architecture/:id — get single architecture (Excalidraw JSON + metadata + attachments)
PUT /api/architecture/:id — save architecture (Excalidraw JSON + metadata)
POST /api/architecture/:id/attach — attach file path to an element
DELETE /api/architecture/:id — delete architecture
All ArangoDB calls via httpx Unix socket to /run/user/1000/embry/memory.sock using /learn, /recall, /store endpoints
NEVER import graph_memory. NEVER write AQL.
Architecture stored as lessons with tags: ['architecture', project-name]
Excalidraw JSON in solution field, metadata (attachments, element-to-file mappings) in JSON
tests: curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/architecture | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert 'architectures' in d"

definition_of_done.command: curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/architecture | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('OK' if 'architectures' in d else 'FAIL')"

tasks.title: Create ArchitectureView.tsx — main view component
tasks.gate: TypeScript compiles AND component matches Stitch mockup layout
implementation: Create /home/graham/workspace/experiments/pi-mono/packages/ux-lab/src/components/architecture/ArchitectureView.tsx
Three-panel layout: LeftPane (project list) | Excalidraw canvas | Right inspector pane
ALL panels resizable via drag handles and collapsible
Import and embed @excalidraw/excalidraw React component with dark theme
Excalidraw theme: match EMBRY bgDeep (#0b1220) background, accent (#7c3aed)
Left pane: reuse LeftPane.tsx + LeftPaneSection from common/
Left pane: architecture project list with right-click context menu (reuse ContextMenu.tsx): Rename, Duplicate, Delete, Version History
Left pane: + button to create new architecture
Right pane: Element Inspector with tabs — Properties, Code, Files
Right pane Properties tab: element name, type, latency, description from element customData
Right pane Code tab: syntax-highlighted code from attached .py/.ts files
Right pane Files tab: list of attached file paths with paperclip icons, + Attach File button
Right pane renders markdown, code, and HTML inline when attachment is clicked
Top bar: architecture project name + Agent indicator (reuse AgentControl.tsx)
Bottom bar: Save to Memory button + Create Plan button
100% compliant with EmbryStyle.ts — import EMBRY tokens, use label/heading styles
Lucide icons for all toolbar controls

tasks.title: Wire Save to Memory — persist Excalidraw JSON to ArangoDB
tasks.gate: PUT saves and GET retrieves same Excalidraw JSON
implementation: Save button calls PUT /api/architecture/:id with Excalidraw scene JSON
Server stores via daemon /learn endpoint with tags ['architecture', project-name]
Versioning: each save creates a new lesson (immutable versions in ArangoDB)
Load on mount: fetch GET /api/architecture/:id and hydrate Excalidraw
Auto-load active architecture at session start for agent context

definition_of_done.command: curl -s -X PUT http://localhost:3001/api/architecture/test -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"elements":[], "name":"test"}' | python3 -c "import json,sys; print('OK' if json.load(sys.stdin).get('saved') else 'FAIL')"

tasks.title: Wire Create Plan — generate /plan YAML from architecture diagram
tasks.gate: POST returns checklist or plan YAML skeleton
implementation: Create Plan button reads all Excalidraw elements + their attachments
POST /api/architecture/:id/plan endpoint
Server extracts: shapes → tasks, arrows → depends_on, attached files → context_files
Runs evaluation checklist: every component has attached docs? no orphan nodes? all files exist?
If checklist passes, generates YAML plan skeleton
Returns plan YAML as response for human review
Checklist items: has Design doc, has Backend Notes, no bespoke duplicates of existing skills

definition_of_done.command: curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/architecture/test/plan | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('OK' if 'tasks' in d or 'checklist' in d else 'FAIL')"
definition_of_done.assertion: Returns OK with tasks or checklist

tasks.title: Agent read/write API — programmatic canvas manipulation
tasks.gate: PATCH adds element and returns updated state
implementation: PATCH /api/architecture/:id/elements — add/modify/delete elements
Agent can add boxes, arrows, text, and attach documents via API
WebSocket channel pushes element changes to browser in real-time
Agent indicator pulses green when agent is modifying canvas
Element customData stores: component name, tech stack, latency, file attachments

definition_of_done.command: curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:3001/api/architecture/test/elements -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"add":[{"type":"rectangle","label":"test-node"}]}' | python3 -c "import json,sys; print('OK' if json.load(sys.stdin).get('updated') else 'FAIL')"

tasks.title: Visual review — screenshot and /review-design
implementation: Start dev server: cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/pi-mono/packages/ux-lab && npm run dev
Navigate to http://localhost:3001/#architecture via /surf
Screenshot the rendered view via /surf snap
Compare against approved Stitch mockup at captures/architecture/simplified/be7b5e7fc1df49a0a4045cc4dc43f6e2.png
Run /review-design with both screenshots
Fix any visual regressions until match_score >= 85

tasks.title: Integration test — full round-trip
tasks.command:
curl -s -X PUT http://localhost:3001/api/architecture/queryspec-pipeline \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"QuerySpec Pipeline","elements":[{"type":"rectangle","id":"1","x":100,"y":100,"width":200,"height":80,"customData":{"label":"Intent Classifier","tech":"SetFit","latency":"<10ms"}}],"attachments":{"1":["scripts/training/sft_queryspec_v3.py"]}}' \
&& curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/architecture/queryspec-pipeline | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'elements: {len(d.get(\"elements\",[]))}, attachments: {len(d.get(\"attachments\",{}))}')" \
&& curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/architecture/queryspec-pipeline/plan | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'plannable: {d.get(\"checklist\",{}).get(\"passed\",False)}')"

definition_of_done.command: curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/architecture | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(len(d.get('architectures',[])) > 0)"
definition_of_done.assertion: Returns True — at least one architecture exists after round-trip
